scope: Reproduce every original road-ribbon point; test the unmodified production capsule at that point and every legal lane on its exact source edge. Heights use that edge plus its actual interpolated height. Core/150m domain checks do not establish car graph reachability. First native helper recovery is intercepted before any placement; this is a diagnostic stop, not a completed chapter.

method.capsuleSource: Actual Player.collide cached _colS, Player.atLevel and exported collideBuildings, without a position-changing solve.
method.footHeight: 0.24 + exact source edge endpoint interpolation; native roadHeight receives both edge and that height hint. Source layer is an ordinal, not metres.
method.boundary: Actual world.district.inside and createFlightBoundary with 150m grace; conservative whole-capsule radius. Not a native car graph reachability proof.
method.longitudinalScan: Every legal lane, <=1m spacing, exact source edge only. It is a bounded static diagnostic, not a continuous steering traversal.
